title: rorca-memory-source-tracking
description: Add a source_type field to memories so users can see HOW each memory was created (run synthesis, manual entry, MCP tool, auto-extracted, import). Display source type badges on the Memory tab and enable filtering by source type.

userStories.title: Add source_type column to memories table
userStories.description: Add a `source_type` column to the `memories` table with an enum constraint: 'synthesis' (post-run LLM analysis), 'manual' (user typed it), 'mcp' (from MCP tool in another project), 'auto-extracted' (from codebase scan/echolocation), 'import' (from migration or bulk import). Default to 'synthesis' for existing rows. Create migration file in backend/src/db/pg-migrations/.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration file adds `source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synthesis'` column to `memories` table
CHECK constraint enforces valid values: 'synthesis', 'manual', 'mcp', 'auto-extracted', 'import'
All existing rows get source_type='synthesis' (the most common creation path)
Index on (workspace_id, source_type) for filtered queries
Migration is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS guards)
Backend type check passes: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Set source_type on all memory creation paths
userStories.description:
Update every code path that creates memories to set the correct source_type value.

1. **memory-synthesis.ts** — when inserting into `memories` table from post-run synthesis, set `source_type = 'synthesis'`
2. **memory.ts POST /api/memory** — when user creates manually via API, set `source_type = 'manual'`. Accept optional `sourceType` param in request body to allow callers to specify (MCP tools will pass 'mcp')
3. **mcp/server.ts rorca_save_memory** — pass `sourceType: 'mcp'` when calling POST /api/memory
4. **mcp/server.ts rorca_log_decision** — pass `sourceType: 'mcp'` when calling POST /api/memory
5. **wal-feedback.ts** — if it creates memories from WAL events, set `source_type = 'auto-extracted'`
6. **memory-ledger.ts append()** — if writing to DB, accept and propagate sourceType parameter
7. **Any bulk import or migration path** — set `source_type = 'import'`
acceptanceCriteria: memory-synthesis.ts sets source_type='synthesis' when inserting into memories table
POST /api/memory accepts optional sourceType in request body, defaults to 'manual'
POST /api/memory validates sourceType against allowed enum values
rorca_save_memory MCP tool passes sourceType='mcp' to POST /api/memory
rorca_log_decision MCP tool passes sourceType='mcp' to POST /api/memory
wal-feedback.ts memory creation (if any) uses source_type='auto-extracted'
memory proposal approval flow (POST /api/memory/proposals approve action) preserves source_type='synthesis'
Backend type check passes: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Return source_type in all memory API responses
userStories.description:
Update memory API endpoints to include source_type in their responses.

1. **GET /api/memory/items** — include `sourceType` field in each memory item
2. **GET /api/memory** (file-based) — infer source_type from existing source field: if source contains a story ID pattern like 'US-XXX' or 'CIE-XXX', return 'synthesis'; if source is 'mcp-cli', return 'mcp'; if empty, return 'manual'
3. **GET /api/memory/proposals** — include source_type in proposal response
4. Update the Swagger/JSDoc annotations for affected endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/memory/items returns sourceType field for each item
GET /api/memory (file-based) infers sourceType from the source field text
GET /api/memory/proposals includes sourceType in response
Swagger annotations updated for all three endpoints
Backend type check passes: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Display source type badges on Memory tab cards
userStories.description:
Update the MemoryPanel.tsx (or DirectionStackPanel.tsx memory tab) to show a source type badge on each memory card. Each source type gets a distinct color and icon:

- **Synthesis** — teal badge with Bot icon (already partially shown, make consistent)
- **Manual** — blue badge with PenLine icon
- **MCP** — purple badge with Plug icon
- **Auto-extracted** — amber badge with Scan icon
- **Import** — gray badge with Import icon

Badge should appear in the metadata row alongside existing category badge, confidence indicator, run ID, and date. Use the same compact badge style (text-[9px] or text-[10px]) as existing badges.

Synthesis: teal bg, Bot icon from lucide-react
Manual: blue bg, PenLine icon from lucide-react
MCP: purple bg, Plug icon from lucide-react

Frontend type check passes: npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Backfill source_type for existing memories
userStories.description:
Write a one-time backfill migration that infers source_type for existing memories rows:

1. If `source_run_id IS NOT NULL` → 'synthesis' (came from a pipeline run)
2. If `source_spec_id IS NOT NULL AND source_run_id IS NULL` → 'auto-extracted' (from spec generation)
3. If `source_story_id IS NULL AND source_run_id IS NULL AND source_spec_id IS NULL` → 'manual' (user created)
4. Leave the default 'synthesis' for any ambiguous cases

This migration should be safe to run multiple times (idempotent).
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file in backend/src/db/pg-migrations/ with correct sequence number
Memories with source_run_id set → source_type='synthesis'
Memories with source_spec_id but no source_run_id → source_type='auto-extracted'
Memories with no source IDs → source_type='manual'
Migration is idempotent (safe to re-run)
Existing source_type values not overwritten if already set to non-default
Backend type check passes: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit
